notes.title: Retro Kart Rush is available now on the Nintendo Switch
notes.notes:
Retro Kart Rush is available now on the Nintendo Switch!

The game was just released on europe and japan, making it available on all regions! if you are interested, please use the link below

https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/retro-kart-rush-switch/

thank you (:

notes.title: Retro Kart Rush is coming to the Nintendo Switch!
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce that Retro Kart Rush will be coming to the Nintendo Switch on September 21.

I partnered up with TuanisApps to create the Nintendo Switch version of the game, and the porting process is almost done! 

You can check out the game's e-shop page right now using the link below:
https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/retro-kart-rush-switch/


Thank you so much for your support and I hope you enjoy the game (:
